definitions.explanation: Making information publicly known; an official statement or release.
Showing or presenting work to an audience, such as research findings or artistic performances.

notes:
USAGE: {発表|はっぴょう} covers both official announcements (news, results) and academic/artistic presentations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {発表|はっぴょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to announce, to present)
- {発表|はっぴょう}によると (according to the announcement)
- ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧ (presentation, recital)
- {発表|はっぴょう}を⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to make an announcement)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい}→発表会：27716_happyoukai⟧ (presentation meeting, recital)
- ⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧{発表|はっぴょう} (press release)
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧{発表|はっぴょう} (research presentation)
- ⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧{発表|はっぴょう} (conference presentation)
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧{発表|はっぴょう} (official announcement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{公表|こうひょう}→公表：11640_kouhyou⟧ - public disclosure (formal)
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ - release for sale
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ - report
